name: Belgian chocolate ice cream
ingredients_raw: Belgian Chocolate Ice Cream: Milk and Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Maltitol, Fructooligosaccharides, Erythritol, Whey Protein Concentrate, Permitted Emulsifying (E471) and Stabilizing (E477, E412, E466, E415, E407, E410) Agents, Stevia. CONTAINS PERMITTED NATURAL COLOUR(S) AND ADDED FLAVOUR(S). MADE IN A FACILITY THAT ALSO PROCESSES NUTS. Allergens: Contains Milk. May contain Soy. Polyols may have laxative effect
